info.description: Sentin8 Hotel8:PMS - Property Management System for the hospitality industry.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/admin/{resource}` - admin data for the RFW tables. Each resource
maps to its Shield `read` action; unknown resources 404.

200.description: OK - resource-polymorphic admin read for the RFW DataTable. Shapes per resource: table resources (reservations, frontdesk, housekeeping, rates, blocks, events, profiles, companies, company_users, negotiated_rates) return {items: [row objects whose cells are all strings]} with per-resource column sets - reservations: id/confirmation_number/guest_name/status/check_in/check_out/num_rooms; frontdesk: id/confirmation_number/guest_name/status/room/checked_in_at; housekeeping: room_number/fo_status/status/assigned_to; rates: id/rate_plan_code/rate_plan_name/rate_category/currency_code/active/min_los/negotiated; blocks: id/block_code/block_name/blocked_rooms/status/start_date/end_date; events: id/event_code/event_name/event_type/status/start_date/end_date/expected_attendees; profiles: id/profile_type/guest_name/email/company_name/loyalty_number/vip_status; companies: id/company_name/email/sso_provider/credit_approvals; company_users: id/role_at_company/is_default/traveler_name/email; negotiated_rates: id/rate_plan_code/rate_plan_name/rate_category/currency_code/active/linked_companies. reports returns a JSON array of {date, reservations, guests}. settings returns {property_code, property_name, timezone, currency_code, languages}. overview returns {arrivals_today, departures_today, in_house, dirty_rooms}.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/admin/{resource}` - form-submit aliases. The RFW renderer only
POSTs; each alias calls the SAME public domain handler (shared business
rules), so the admin surface can create/update/delete exactly what staff
can.

200.description: OK - resource-polymorphic submit alias; the response is the aliased public handler's typed response verbatim (reservations: ReservationResponse; blocks: BlockCreated; events: EventCreated; profiles: ProfileCreated; company_payment_methods: CompanyPaymentMethod; company_users: CompanyUserBound; rate_links: LinkCompanyResult). The request body is the aliased handler's typed request, except rate_links which reads {company_profile_id, rate_plan_id}.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/properties/{property_id}/corporate-availability` - availability
for a corporate session (company_profile_id). Rate-mix policy: when the
request carries a company context, ONLY the negotiated rate plans linked
to that company (via `preferences.negotiated_rate_plan_ids`) are returned;
public plans are withheld so negotiated rates never leak to non-members
and members never book public rates against their contract. Companies
with no linked plans get an explicit empty result, not a public fallback.

put.description:
Edits dates, occupancy, room type, rate plan, and special requests.
Terminal-status reservations (`CANCELLED`, `CHECKED_OUT`, `NO_SHOW`) refuse
edits with 409 - the state machine forbids mutating history.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/properties/{p}/reservations/{res_id}/link-guest` - bind the
signed-in session's guest profile to a booking made anonymously in eBooking.
post.description:
The binding surface is the profile chain: the anonymous booking carries the
booker profile row; signing in resolves the (possibly different) profile
the session subject owns. Linking merges the booker profile INTO the
session's profile via the same merge path ePMS staff use, so folio/keys/
requests all follow the stay.

400.description: No profile bound to this session; supply target_profile_id

404.description: Reservation not found (or has no booker profile)

post.description:
Creates a `CONFIRMED` reservation from an available room type + guest name
(`source_code = 'WALKIN'`, `channel_code = 'KIOSK'`). The kiosk then
check-ins via the normal route. Refuses when the room type has no
availability for the requested window.

200.description: OK - CONFIRMED reservation for the kiosk to check in

409.description: Room type sold out for the window
